snippet.title: Welcome to TRAPPIST-1
snippet.description:
Forty light-years from Earth, seven rocky worlds circle a dim red star. Your expedition is our first step towards the stars. You have just arrived at humanity's next home, and so have others.

TRAPPIST-1 is a hard sci-fi colony strategy game set in a real star system. Mine, manufacture and build across hex-mapped planets, plan cargo runs on true orbital trajectories, and scan for rival expeditions hiding in the dark. Become the first expedition to settle another system, sending humanity onwards to the next star.

FEATURES
- Seven worlds based on the real TRAPPIST-1 system
- Surface industry and orbital logistics in one connected economy
- Real orbital mechanics, with three clear route choices for every journey
- Scanning, stealth and incomplete information
- A new system every playthrough
- Single-player against AI expeditions, pausable at any time

TRAPPIST-1 is made by a solo developer and is coming to Steam Early Access. Wishlisting is the best way to support the game and to hear when it launches.

Wishlist TRAPPIST-1 on store.steampowered.com/app/5423750
